verdict.rationale: ClickUp ships AI agents (Brain², Super Agent, Build your own agent), so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can act as an MCP client. However, the evidence only documents ClickUp's own MCP server, which lets external assistants like Claude reach ClickUp data. That is the server role and does not transfer to this story. Brain²'s built-in connectors to Google Drive, GitHub and Salesforce are adjacent features, not documented support for plugging in arbitrary MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
